slides.title: A default 30-day deadline
slides.body: If no payment date was agreed, a business customer's payment is generally due 30 days after the invoice or delivery, whichever is later.

slides.title: Statutory interest
slides.body: You can claim interest at 8% above the Bank of England base rate on late business-to-business invoices.

slides.title: Reasonable recovery costs
slides.body: If the fixed sum doesn't cover what you reasonably spent chasing the debt, you may be able to claim the difference.

slides.headline: Know your rights. [Keep the record.]
slides.body: PayReso keeps invoices, reminders and evidence in one timeline.

captions.linkedin:
Paid late by a business customer? UK law gives you more than a polite reminder.

Most small business owners I speak to don't know these four rights under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998:

1. If no date was agreed, payment is generally due 30 days after the invoice or delivery.
2. You can claim statutory interest at 8% above the Bank of England base rate.
3. You can add fixed compensation: £40 (under £1,000), £70 (£1,000–£9,999.99) or £100 (£10,000+).
4. You may be able to claim reasonable extra recovery costs.

Knowing your rights is step one. Step two is a clean record of what you sent and when. That's the part PayReso handles for UK businesses.

Have you ever added late payment interest to an overdue invoice, or does it feel too awkward with a customer you want to keep?

General information, not legal advice.

slides.sub: Many accounts teams slow down or close over Christmas. Get invoices in early.

captions.linkedin:
An invoice sent on 22 December can easily sit untouched until mid-January.

Many accounts teams run reduced hours, or close completely, between Christmas and New Year. For UK small businesses, that gap hits cash flow hard.

Three things that help:
• Send December invoices as soon as the work is done
• Ask your customer when their last payment run is before the break
• Check the invoice is going to the right person in accounts
